dct_description_sm: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means [here](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tags) ) : tags['aeroway'] IS NOT NULL OR tags['building'] = 'aerodrome' OR tags['emergency:helipad'] IS NOT NULL OR tags['emergency'] = 'landing_site' Features may have these attributes: - [name](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name) - [name:en](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:en) - [aeroway](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:aeroway) - [building](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:building) - [emergency](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:emergency) - [emergency:helipad](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:emergency:helipad) - [operator:type](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:operator:type) - [capacity:persons](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:capacity:persons) - [addr:full](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:full) - [addr:city](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:city) - [source](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:source) - [name:hr](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:hr) This dataset is one of many [OpenStreetMap exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot). See the [Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team](http://hotosm.org/) website for more information.
